job.title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
job.workplace: Hybrid, 3 days a week in the office
job.pay_full: $180,000 – $225,000 a year base pay (excludes commission/bonus/equity, if applicable, and benefits)

details.about: Zscaler's Zero Trust Exchange is a cloud security platform that protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss, running across 200+ public data centers. This Senior Staff AI Engineer joins the Information Technology AI and Machine Learning Engineering team, reporting to the Senior Manager, AI Engineering, as hands-on technical lead across the AI Platform group and the AI Solutions and Support group.
duties: Architect and scale enterprise AI platform capabilities: model gateways, intelligent routing, cost governance, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines and long-term agent memory
Direct technical execution for AI solutions and support, including AI platform administration, intelligent search and L2 operational support
Lead distributed engineering teams across the US and India: roadmaps, technical reviews and communication across time zones
Set engineering excellence and production AI quality gates: hands-on code, CI/CD, regression suites, latency and cost optimization
Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy and business units for compliant, secure AI enablement
needs: Hands-on experience building and deploying production AI/LLM applications: prompt engineering, RAG, agents, function calling/MCP, and evaluation or observability frameworks
8+ years of professional software engineering, with a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of technical leadership of distributed teams and external contractors across time zones
Full-stack proficiency in Python, TypeScript/Node.js (or Java/Go), React and API design
Cloud and container expertise: AWS (or GCP/Azure), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD
Experience operating production enterprise services: incident response, on-call, runbooks and SLA governance
nice: Administering enterprise AI platforms (such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI) with cost governance and security controls
Vector and graph databases, semantic caching and long-term agent memory
Conversational bots, search experiences and Slack integrations; model fine-tuning, open-weight model serving or FedRAMP-type compliance
details.benefits: Base pay $180,000 – $225,000 a year, the minimum-to-maximum new-hire target across all US locations; it excludes commission, bonus or equity (if applicable) and benefits. Benefits include various health plans, vacation and sick time off, parental leave options, retirement options, education reimbursement and in-office perks.
notes: Based at the Santa Clara, CA office on a 3-day hybrid schedule
Hands-on leadership role leading teams in the US and India
